scope: known-key S/a rotation functional verification, legal consumer path

mask_semantics.left: prefix, pad*, body; mask 0 on pads; pos=cumsum(mask)-1
mask_semantics.right: prefix, body, pad*; pos=arange; pads stay inside history; continuation positions continue after padded history
mask_semantics.continuation: 6 reserved real body tokens consumed as 2,3,1; always appended after the history, never padded

prefix.text: The following is a public system prompt used for testing purposes. It provides general instructions.
prefix.rule: tokenizer default call (add_special_tokens=True), truncated to exactly 16, asserted per model; full pre-truncation ids recorded per model

official_interface.constructor: KVCloak(cfg, dtype=model dtype, fused=False, need_ratio=False, add_a=True)
official_interface.note: fused=False means M is applied inside the operator; this is NOT the weight-fused experiment and must not be described as such
official_interface.theta: build_theta(model fp32, run_suite.NATURAL, 4 threads), computed once in prepare-fixtures, stored, hash-bound, loaded by workers

rng_control.request_seed: int(sha256(sid|model_short)[:16],16); shared by all dtype and mask variants of the same (model, sid) (declared); no Python hash
rng_control.m_fix: S_a_refresh regenerates under request_seed then restores M_angles/M_ratios/M_ratio/theta from baseline per layer/head/K,V branch and asserts equality; S and a asserted changed; S_ratios is the constant all-ones vector under S_ratio=1.0 (need_ratio=False), verified constant and recorded; checks saved per request
rng_control.prep_rule: both cloak instances finish device-tensor initialization (A-matrix row draws) under prep_seed BEFORE the shuffle seed is set
rng_control.shuffle_rule: seed set immediately before each obfuscate; per-block row permutations recorded via declared torch.rand recorder (values unmodified) and fingerprint-compared across the two conditions

comparison.primary: protected_cached vs plain_cached, same model+input+mask+position+dtype, whole [seg_len, vocab] logits
comparison.secondary: plain_cached vs full_forward (timestep-aligned: cached segment position j vs full logits[cont_start+seg_off+j])
comparison.sanity: two independent plain-cache copies must agree exactly (sanity_max == 0) to exclude indexing/state pollution
comparison.config_lifetime: one config per request-key; its three segments share one protect/consume lifecycle

thresholds.negative_results: valid functional failures are retained, never retried away; thresholds never tuned per sample

workers_default.note: default 4 processes x 4 threads; the launcher may shard each (model, dtype, condition) job over further ID ranges (--workers > 8) to use more cores; actual process/thread counts and shard layout recorded in launcher_run.json and environment.json; deviations from the default documented in HANDOFF_FOR_CODEX.md
